title: story-067 zero-haircut FLOOR measures the buffer-inflated strategy principalOf, not user-withdrawable totalStaked, so a genuine per-user haircut passes the gate even on a CLEAN run
rootCause: The step-9 floor require(principalOf(token, original) >= preMigBooked) compares against principalOf, which INCLUDES the protocol-owned, unattributed skim+idle buffer folded in by setYieldStrategy — not the user-withdrawable poolInfo.totalStaked. The buffer (~27.45 DOLA on the fork) always dwarfs a per-user haircut, so the gate passes even when users were collectively shorted.
impact: Gate-blindness: the floor does not enforce story-067's stated 'never haircut a staker' invariant because it measures the wrong quantity. On the in-scope autoDOLA/autoUSD ERC4626 strategies the realized leak is redeem-rounding dust (~0.024% round-trip; fork: -0.1647 DOLA on 1033.8 booked; a single user -0.243 DOLA) and the buffer masks it. Material loss would require a HYPOTHETICAL future YS-swap reusing this gate against a market/AMM strategy with real slippage.
attackPath: 1. A normal (clean, non-resume) two-leg bounce runs with a correct non-zero preMigBooked anchor.
2. Leg-2 redeposit incurs ERC4626 redeem rounding so users collectively lose dust (fork: -0.1647 DOLA on 1033.8 booked).
3. The step-9 floor require(principalOf >= preMigBooked) still passes because principalOf (~1061) exceeds preMigBooked (~1033.9) thanks to the ~27.45 DOLA protocol-owned buffer.
4. The 'never haircut a staker' invariant the gate is supposed to enforce is not actually enforced; the dust haircut passes silently.
recommendation: Compare against poolInfo.totalStaked (the user-withdrawable principal), not principalOf (which is buffer-inflated). Keep the '>=' direction so legitimate surplus does not falsely revert. This removes the buffer's masking effect and makes the gate enforce the actual zero-haircut invariant for users on every run.

poc.note: Referenced end-to-end bounce test (PASS); demonstrates the gate passing despite a per-user dust haircut on the current ERC4626 strategies.

severityRationale: Low: the gate genuinely measures the wrong comparand and fails even on a clean run, but the actual leak on the in-scope ERC4626 strategies is rounding dust (project dust/rounding -> QA/Low rule). The amplification scenario (material haircut sliding past the blind gate) depends on a future YS-swap against a high-slippage market strategy — speculation on future code, kept at Low absent a demonstrated current root-cause impact. Complementary to YS-26 (anchor-zeroing), not a duplicate. Distinct from ledger YS-05/5c9f1cee (haircut MAGNITUDE) — this is the gate-BLINDNESS to it.
faithfulnessRationale: Tagged faithfulness:true (Law 2): the gate does not enforce story-067's stated 'never haircut a staker' invariant (wrong comparand). Report as F-XX in spec-conformance even though the security impact is Low — a behavioural deviation is visible to the owner, never dropped into gas noise.
threeLawFraming: Law 2 (faithfulness) carries this finding into spec-conformance visibility; Law 1 sets honest severity at Low (dust on in-scope strategies). Not an owner footgun on its own.
